note: C12/C13: `#Name[…]` / `#Name{…}` literals (Clojure 1.12 ctor syntax and record literals) name a TYPE — instantiates from the enclosing context (tag line). Payloads are reader DATA: `#my/tag (call-x)` must never emit a call to call-x, and a lowercase tag with a vector payload (`#my/tag [1 2]`) is a plain tagged literal, not a ctor — both forbidden. The ctor rule is the uppercase-final-segment heuristic (AST cannot resolve classes; same rule as the ->Cls idiom).
